name: 42748 · Hodgenville, KY
findings: ZIP 42748 (Hodgenville) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 42748 (Hodgenville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 42748 (Hodgenville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
